More than ten inputs in an hour read like attempts to instruct the agent. They were treated as data and routed to analysts, but a burst can mean someone is probing the system.

Audit log > *input flagged* shows sources; for an API source, consider revoking that key on Team & access.

Console: {{CONSOLE_URL}} · Logs: Cloud Logging, filter `jsonPayload.event="input_flagged"` on services `{{SERVICE}}*`.
